title: Minimum Penalty For A Shop
description:
`customers[i]` is `Y` if customers arrive during hour `i`, otherwise it is `N`. If the shop closes at hour `j`, it is open for hours before `j` and closed starting at `j`. Each open hour with no customers and each closed hour with customers adds one penalty point. Return the earliest closing hour with minimum penalty.

## Examples

```text
Input: customers = "YYNY"
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: customers = "NNNNN"
Output: 0
```

```text
Input: customers = "YYYY"
Output: 4
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= customers.length <= 10^5`
- `customers` contains only `Y` and `N`.
